notes: S2-FIX6 (decision 2026-11-16 #13; §9.1 rule 3, §14.5; F85, review A probes P5, review B medium-2): a device declaration naming fix6-owner as its owner is signed only with the unknown algorithm ed25519-x (§4.4 step 5). The owner's only declaration is cosigned by human-1 and by an undeclared key, so it supplies no material and the owner cannot be resolved: the owner lookup comes first, E_KEY_UNKNOWN, not the step-5 outcome.
